# Fluid motion, tactile feedback, and interactive animations

- HARD USER REQUIREMENT: all interactive elements must feel fluid, reactive, and physically responsive to mouse hovers, focus, and clicks. Nothing in the interface should feel instant, stiff, or abrupt.
- Apply tailored cubic-bezier easing curves (such as `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`) across interactive element transitions: background-color, border-color, box-shadow, and transform.
- Interactive controls (buttons, chips, cards, list rows, badges, inputs) must provide clear tactile feedback: subtle hover lift and soft elevation glow on hover, followed by a slight physical depression or scale down (e.g. `scale(0.98)`) on `:active:not(:disabled)`.
- Modals, sheets, tooltips, command dialogs, and floating bulk action bars must enter and exit smoothly with spring scale and backdrop fade rather than snapping into view instantly.
- Contextual actions, toolbar triggers, and state feedback must incorporate animated Lucide icons from Animate UI (located in `src/client/components/ui/AnimatedIcon.tsx`), including Search, Refresh, Plus, Download, ExternalLink, Arrow navigation, Check, Copy, Trash, and X close.
- HARD USER REQUIREMENT: save and form commit buttons across the workspace must use the interactive state-switching button effect (`StateButton`, derived from Magic UI Animated Subscribe Button, Motion spring transitions, and Animate UI animated icons): smoothly morphing from idle state through an active saving state with tactile spinner feedback to a confirmed saved state before completing or settling.
- Animated icons should activate cleanly on hover (`animateOnHover`) or tap, enhancing clarity without interrupting user tasks or workflow rhythm.
- Respect reduced motion accessibility unconditionally: honor `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)` and Motion's `<MotionConfig reducedMotion="user">`.
- Animated decoration must never leak into printed or generated PDF documents. Enforce clean document layouts under `@media print` and inside PDF generation pipelines.
